OCTOBER 8, 2025 The substantive prayer in the petition is as under :
"i) direct the respondent nos.8 to 10 to take the cognizance of the representation/report dated 22/7/2019 and representation/report dated 1/8/2019 annexed at (Annexure-I) and further be pleased to direct the respondent nos. 8 to 10 to register the cognizable offence under Section 420, 406 of Indian Penal Code and under the relevant provisions of Multi-State Co-Operative Societies Act and The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 and The Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act, 1999, against the respondent no.11 and all their Board of Directors, in the interest of justice;"
2] As could be seen, the petitioners seek directions to register First Information Report in terms of their representation/report dated 22/7/2019.
